title: Portstone and RiskMandate

scenes.kicker: RiskMandate · a story made at the summit
scenes.title: Portstone and RiskMandate
scenes.caption: For Portstone

scenes.title: Portstone: people on the phone, end to end
items: A cold calling agency for B2B campaigns
Trained callers assigned to each campaign
Run end to end: target list to meetings on the client's calendar
Outbound strategy, list building, script writing, SDR placement and training, cold calling, weekly reporting
Callers are people, selected, trained and managed by Portstone
scenes.caption: From Portstone's own pages. Their site names no AI agents in its own process.
say: Portstone is a human outbound phone channel, and says so.
We do not claim any AI agents on their side.

scenes.title: How a Portstone campaign runs
steps: Dial volume and connect rate worked backwards
Every list row checked: company, person, role
Trained callers dial from an approved script
Every call recorded, sent with the weekly report
scenes.caption: Recordings are attached to the record they belong to. Portstone does not guarantee meetings.
say: It starts from the revenue goal and works back to the dials.
Recorded calls and weekly reporting make the work easy to inspect.

scenes.title: Pricing per campaign
scenes.caption: No setup fees, no long-term contract. Their published prices, not a quote for us.
say: Clear, per-campaign pricing makes a small pilot easy to size.

scenes.title: The fit runs the other way round

before.label: Not the first fit
items: Portstone's own work is done by people
Its site names no AI agents

after.label: The better fit
items: Portstone as an outbound phone channel for RiskMandate
Selling agent-risk assessments and summit packages
Calling B2B tech companies that run AI agents

scenes.caption: Built from public pages only; nothing of Portstone's was tested.
say: Measurement is not where we start with a human-run team.
The partnership is a reseller or pipeline arrangement.

scenes.title: What we would do together
steps: Agree the offer: assessments and summit packages
Portstone builds and checks the target list
Trained callers dial B2B tech companies running AI agents
scenes.caption: What we would do together, not a claim by either company. Details to be agreed.
say: Portstone's existing process carries the campaign; RiskMandate supplies the offer.
Reseller or pipeline partner: the shape is open for discussion.

scenes.title: What we do not know yet
items: Mandate for agents: unknown; the script is a written mandate for a human caller
Reach: touches client target lists, call recordings and CRM-style records
Whether AI tooling sits behind list sourcing or connect-rate optimisation: unknown
If Portstone adds AI to sourcing, dialling or reporting, mandate, reach and gap measurement applies there
scenes.caption: Unknown from public pages. We would ask, not assume.
say: We name what we cannot see.
Measurement stays on the table if AI enters their process later.

scenes.text: Portstone brings the human callers; RiskMandate brings the agent-risk offer. Together, a phone channel to B2B tech companies that run AI agents.
scenes.caption: A partnership proposal from us, for discussion. Not a claim by either company.
say: Start small: one campaign, one offer, clear reporting.

scenes.title: Three ways to start
items: £500 · ABP Tailored: your deployment, reflected in the mandate, corrected by a named security professional (1 to 3 days)
£1,500 · ABP Reviewed: two sessions with your team and a custom vault, signed off by a security professional (1 to 5 days)
£5,000 · A deeper engagement: your agents mapped, mandated and measured with us, end to end
Summit promotion: commit today and take 25% off any of these, or, with the £1,500 or £5,000 package, a tablet set up for you.
scenes.caption: agent@riskmandate.ai · store.sgit.ai
say: Pick the level that fits: tailored, reviewed, or end to end.
